text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян manages to leave quite a
mark on
the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
One day, while we bask in the greatness
of our
victories...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And that concludes the announcement
of this
year's star Umamusume. Next...
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text:
This year, at the request of Tracen
Academy's
director, we have added an
extra award for a
particular Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text:
One who has left a huge mark on the
racing
world...
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян! Please come up to the
podium!
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text: Coming! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Каррен Тян, you've
thrilled the
racing world—not only with
your races but also
with your
extraordinary social media presence!
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава

text_block_list.text:
For this, it's my honor to present you
with the new
CC Award!
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава

text_block_list.text: CC Award? Is that...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Clarification! The official name is the
"Crown of
Cuteness Award"!
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава

text_block_list.text: A-a crown of cuteness?!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I'm so... happy. Thank you so much! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I did it, Big Bro!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I did it, Big Sis!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
"Big Bro"? Do you have family with you
here
tonight?
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis"? Do you have family with you
here
tonight?
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text:
Well... They're more like a friend who I
love like
family. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Ehe! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
With that heart-pounding statement,
Curren
Chan becomes the most beloved
runner in both
name and reality!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: A bit later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just one more question, please. Today,
you
received a special award.
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
Where exactly do you want to go from
here?
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text: I've already decided, of course. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Having received this award today, I think
that my
work here might just be finished.
So next...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I wanna run internationally!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
There are so many people who haven't
been lucky
enough to meet Cute Curren
Chan yet.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna run a special delivery of
cuteness to
them, wherever they may
be! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
It's time to expand my circle of
cuteness. ♪ I'm
coming for you,
everyone!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
After the interview airs, "Curren" starts
trending
worldwide. Then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Big Bro! I finished checking in!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Big Sis! I finished checking in!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Before I realize it, we're at the airport
ready to
set off!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Are you still half asleep? C'mon! Stay
with me
here!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Today's a brand new day on my path to
cuteness.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
After "cute" is "super cute." And after
that is
"super-duper cute"...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
My dream's endless, and I'm gonna
chase it
forever. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
You know... I'm totally convinced I can
do it.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm with you... I can spread my
cuteness
throughout the whole wide
world.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm with you... I can spread my
cuteness
throughout the whole wide
world.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Aaaand!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I bet I could even take on the universe!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I bet I could even take on the universe!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
So don't you take your eyes off of me,
okay? ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
So don't you take your eyes off of me,
okay? ♪
